title: Lioness
synopsis: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.

episodes.title: Sacrificial Soldiers
episodes.synopsis: Things go awry for Joe and her team during a mission out in the field. Joe is left devastated. Upon her return home, Joe's family life presents it's own challenges. Cruz tries to escape a dangerous situation. Joe must choose an agent.

episodes.title: The Beating
episodes.synopsis: Joe continues her training with Cruz whose methods are questionable. Cruz starts to build a relationship with Aaliyah. Kate gets into a fight during her soccer game. Neal has to deliver difficult news to a patient.

episodes.title: Bruise Like a Fist
episodes.synopsis: Cruz is invited to spend the weekend with Aaliyah and her inner-circle. Joe keeps Kaitlyn informed of Cruz's progress. Kyle comes to Joe desperate for help with an asset.

episodes.title: The Choice of Failure
episodes.synopsis: Cruz is put in a compromising position while out with Aaliyah and friends in the Hamptons, causing Joe and Kaitlyn to doubt her. Kaitlyn and Westfield confront Kyle over what happened at the border, complicating things further for Joe and her team.

episodes.title: Truth Is the Shrewdest Lie
episodes.synopsis: Joe and Neal deal with the aftermath of Kate's accident. Westfield and Kaitlyn deploy Joe's team to subdue a terrorist threat. Cruz's cover may be in jeopardy.

episodes.title: The Lie Is the Truth
episodes.synopsis: Aaliyah bonds with Cruz over a spa day. Bobby, Tex, Two Cups, Randy and Tucker confront a threat at the Safe House. Kaitlyn and Joe are scolded for the San Antonio mission in a debrief.

episodes.title: Wish the Fight Away
episodes.synopsis: While shopping in Manhattan for the wedding, Aaliyah and Cruz get closer. Kate returns home only to say goodbye to her mom once again. Joe guides Cruz through internal struggle and doubt in completing the mission.

episodes.title: Gone Is the Illusion of Order
episodes.synopsis: Unforeseen circumstances leaves the mission in jeopardy. A suspicious Ehsan confronts Cruz before his wedding day. Joe and the team prepare for the worst.

episodes.title: Beware the Old Soldier
episodes.synopsis: Joe, Kyle, and the QRF team embark on a timely extraction after a high-ranking government official is kidnapped by a cartel.

episodes.title: I Love My Country
episodes.synopsis: After a new Lioness is identified, Joe and her team travel to Iraq to close the asset.

episodes.title: Along Came a Spider
episodes.synopsis: Kaitlyn works to drum up support for their plan. Meanwhile, Lioness training begins for Captain Josie Carrillo.

episodes.title: Five Hundred Children
episodes.synopsis: Joe and Kyle make contact with a potential new source of intel. A newly expanded team conducts a hit with unanticipated results.

episodes.title: Shatter the Moon
episodes.synopsis: The warehouse discovery rattles the team. Joe is torn between two urgent missions.
Events come to a head at the Carrillo estate faster than expected. Josie makes her move.

episodes.title: The Devil Has Aces
episodes.synopsis: Despite Joe's weakened state, the team is forced back to Iraq to make a point.

episodes.title: The Compass Points Home
episodes.synopsis: Operation Sky Hawk is a go as Kaitlyn and Westfield pressure Pablo to side with them.

episodes.title: The Spider and the Fly
episodes.synopsis: A covert strike draws Joe into a chain of events.

episodes.title: No Sorrow Like the Survivor
episodes.synopsis: Kaitlyn races to contain a crisis spiraling across agencies; Neal tries to steady rising fear at home.

episodes.title: The Bear Is Infected
episodes.synopsis: Joe confronts a breach, driving the team into a risky play to root out infiltrators.

episodes.title: Murder Hornets
episodes.synopsis: A frantic hunt is launched as the team races against time; at home, Neal struggles with growing fears.

episodes.title: The Idiot Army
episodes.synopsis: Joe leads the hunt as her team exposes a hidden network operating through covert handlers, while Kaitlyn and Westfield hustle to assess the threat.
